questions.EnglishQuestionDetails:
Pass the entries in the books of Salman and Rizwan and also give Rizwan’s ledger account.

Salman sold goods to Rizwan for Rs. 100,000 on 1st July 2022 and drew on him a bill for the amount payable after four months. Rizwan accepted the bill. Salman got it discounted by his bank at 12% p.a. On maturity Rizwan was in a position to pay only Rs. 40,000 in cash, therefore, he approached Salman for the renewal of the bill, Salman agreed and drew a new bill for Rs. 60,000 along with an interest at 15% p.a. for 3 months. Before the due date of the new bill Rizwan became insolvent and a first and final divided of 50% was received from his estate.
